mentions.name: Double-entry trade ERP
mentions.description: An ERP rebuilt around a plaintext-accounting-inspired model that extends double entry accounting to double entry trade between parties, aimed at collapsing complications typical of ERP systems. It uses a textual DSL to model business scenarios (e.g., a sale spanning multiple invoices across countries and currencies, with intermediate steps like transportation and manufacturing) and includes a simplified price engine that avoids dynamic calculations.
mentions.problem: ERP systems are typically complicated, especially price engines with dynamic calculations; this project simplifies the model and the price engine for most cases.
mentions.source_excerpt: Rebuilding my ERP to work more like the model of https://plaintextaccounting.org, where I expanded the idea of `double entry accounting` to `double entry trade between parties`, plus several other ideas for what I see a way to collapse a lot of complications that are typically for ERP systems.
